---------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m6p3t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Car, Bay, noBay, Lease, MaxClock

ASSUME Lease \in Nat /\ MaxClock \in Nat

VARIABLES held, expiry, clock, down
vars == <<held, expiry, clock, down>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ held \in [Car -> Bay \cup {noBay}]
    /\ expiry \in [Car -> 0..(MaxClock + Lease)]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ down \subseteq Car

ActiveHolder(c) == held[c] # noBay /\ clock < expiry[c]

BayFree(b) == \A c \in Car : (held[c] = b) => clock >= expiry[c]

Init ==
    /\ held = [c \in Car |-> noBay]
    /\ expiry = [c \in Car |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ down = {}

Acquire(c, b) ==
    /\ c \notin down
    /\ ~ActiveHolder(c)
    /\ BayFree(b)
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![c] = b]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![c] = clock + Lease]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, down>>

Renew(c) ==
    /\ c \notin down
    /\ ActiveHolder(c)
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![c] = clock + Lease]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, clock, down>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ c \notin down
    /\ held[c] # noBay
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![c] = noBay]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![c] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, down>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ c \notin down
    /\ down' = down \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, expiry, clock>>

Recover(c) ==
    /\ c \in down
    /\ down' = down \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, expiry, clock>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, expiry, down>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Car, b \in Bay : Acquire(c, b)
    \/ \E c \in Car : Renew(c)
    \/ \E c \in Car : Release(c)
    \/ \E c \in Car : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Car : Recover(c)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A c1, c2 \in Car :
        (c1 # c2 /\ held[c1] # noBay /\ held[c1] = held[c2] /\ clock < expiry[c1])
            => clock >= expiry[c2]
=============================================================================

nl: A car-wash conveyor line has several wash bays. Cars on the conveyor acquire a lease on a bay before entering it; each lease carries an expiry time measured against a shared clock. A car may acquire a free bay (one with no unexpired lease) provided it does not already hold an active lease, renew its own active lease to push the expiry forward, or release its bay when it is done. Time advances by ticking the shared clock. Any car may crash silently at any moment: once crashed it stops renewing, so its lingering lease simply expires and the bay becomes free again; a crashed car may later recover and rejoin the line. SAFETY PROPERTY: no two distinct cars ever hold active, unexpired leases on the same wash bay at the same time.

    /\ i \notin record

    /\ record' = record \cup {Head(queue)}
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<accepted, cap>>

    /\ i \in record
    /\ i \notin accepted
    /\ accepted' = accepted \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, record, cap>>

    /\ i \in record
    /\ i \notin accepted
    /\ record' = record \ {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, accepted, cap>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, record, accepted>>

    \/ \E i \in Item : Enqueue(i)
    \/ Commit
    \/ \E i \in Item : Ack(i)
    \/ \E i \in Item : Purge(i)
    \/ SetCap

nl: A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker feeds match requests through a bounded work queue into a shared roster record. New requests are enqueued only while the queue has room beneath its current capacity, providing backpressure; when the queue is full the request is refused. A worker commits the head request into the shared record, and a separate acknowledgement step marks a stored request as accepted once it is durably in the record. CONSTANTS Car, Call, Inst, none, noCall, noCar

VARIABLES holderInst, holderCall, localOwn, active

TypeOK ==
    /\ holderInst \in [Car -> Inst \cup {none}]
    /\ holderCall \in [Car -> Call \cup {noCall}]
    /\ localOwn \in [Inst -> [Call -> Car \cup {noCar}]]
    /\ active \subseteq Call

Init ==
    /\ holderInst = [c \in Car |-> none]
    /\ holderCall = [c \in Car |-> noCall]
    /\ localOwn = [i \in Inst |-> [k \in Call |-> noCar]]
    /\ active = {}

Ring(k) ==
    /\ k \notin active
    /\ active' = active \cup {k}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holderInst, holderCall, localOwn>>

Claim(i, k, c) ==
    /\ k \in active
    /\ holderInst[c] = none
    /\ localOwn[i][k] = noCar
    /\ holderInst' = [holderInst EXCEPT ![c] = i]
    /\ holderCall' = [holderCall EXCEPT ![c] = k]
    /\ localOwn' = [localOwn EXCEPT ![i][k] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED active

Release(i, k) ==
    /\ localOwn[i][k] # noCar
    /\ LET c == localOwn[i][k] IN
        /\ holderInst' = [holderInst EXCEPT ![c] = none]
        /\ holderCall' = [holderCall EXCEPT ![c] = noCall]
        /\ localOwn' = [localOwn EXCEPT ![i][k] = noCar]
    /\ UNCHANGED active

Done(k) ==
    /\ k \in active
    /\ \A i \in Inst : localOwn[i][k] = noCar
    /\ active' = active \ {k}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holderInst, holderCall, localOwn>>

Next ==
    \/ \E k \in Call : Ring(k)
    \/ \E i \in Inst, k \in Call, c \in Car : Claim(i, k, c)
    \/ \E i \in Inst, k \in Call : Release(i, k)
    \/ \E k \in Call : Done(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A i \in Inst, k \in Call :
        localOwn[i][k] # noCar =>
            /\ holderInst[localOwn[i][k]] = i
            /\ holderCall[localOwn[i][k]] = k

nl: An elevator bank in a skyscraper is driven by two independent dispatcher instances that share one common pool of elevator cars. Each car carries a compare-and-swap ownership register naming the instance and hall call that currently own it. A hall call may start ringing. A dispatcher instance claims a free car for a ringing call by compare-and-swapping the car's register from free to itself, but only if it has not already secured a car for that call. It later releases the car, clearing the register back to free. A ringing call is marked done once no instance holds a car for it. SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a dispatcher instance believes it holds a car for a call, that car's ownership register names exactly that instance and that call, so no car is ever double-allocated to two different calls at once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m1p4t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS N, Order, CAP

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N > 0 /\ CAP \in Nat

Participant == 0..(N - 1)
Succ(p) == (p + 1) % N
OwnerOf(o) == o % N

VARIABLES token, book, admin, closed
vars == <<token, book, admin, closed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Participant
    /\ book \subseteq Order
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN
    /\ closed \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ book = {}
    /\ admin = FALSE
    /\ closed = FALSE

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, admin, closed>>

Submit(o) ==
    /\ ~closed
    /\ OwnerOf(o) = token
    /\ o \notin book
    /\ Cardinality(book) < CAP
    /\ book' = book \cup {o}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, admin, closed>>

AdminSubmit(o) ==
    /\ ~closed
    /\ admin
    /\ o \notin book
    /\ Cardinality(book) < CAP
    /\ book' = book \cup {o}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, admin, closed>>

Cancel(o) ==
    /\ o \in book
    /\ book' = book \ {o}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, admin, closed>>

ToggleAdmin ==
    /\ admin' = ~admin
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, book, closed>>

Close ==
    /\ ~closed
    /\ closed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, book, admin>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E o \in Order : Submit(o)
    \/ \E o \in Order : AdminSubmit(o)
    \/ \E o \in Order : Cancel(o)
    \/ ToggleAdmin
    \/ Close

nl: A stock exchange opening auction collects orders into a bounded order book before the market opens. Exclusive write access to the book is granted by a token that circulates around a ring of participants; the token is passed from one participant to the next around the ring. While the auction is open, the current token holder may submit one of its own orders into the book, provided the book has not reached its fixed capacity, and any participant may cancel an order already in the book, freeing a slot. A privileged admin override may be toggled on or off; while it is on, the admin may submit any order into the book without holding the ring token, but it still respects the book's capacity. CONSTANTS Robot, Aisle, Slot, none, noAisle, noBin, TotalCap

Bin == Aisle \X Slot
AisleOf(b) == b[1]

VARIABLES aisleLock, binLock, held, fineHeld, load
vars == <<aisleLock, binLock, held, fineHeld, load>>

RECURSIVE SumLoad(_)
SumLoad(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN load[x] + SumLoad(S \ {x})

TotalLoad == SumLoad(Bin)

TypeOK ==
    /\ aisleLock \in [Aisle -> Robot \cup {none}]
    /\ binLock \in [Bin -> Robot \cup {none}]
    /\ held \in [Robot -> Aisle \cup {noAisle}]
    /\ fineHeld \in [Robot -> Bin \cup {noBin}]
    /\ load \in [Bin -> 0..TotalCap]

Init ==
    /\ aisleLock = [a \in Aisle |-> none]
    /\ binLock = [b \in Bin |-> none]
    /\ held = [r \in Robot |-> noAisle]
    /\ fineHeld = [r \in Robot |-> noBin]
    /\ load = [b \in Bin |-> 0]

LockAisle(r, a) ==
    /\ aisleLock[a] = none
    /\ held[r] = noAisle
    /\ aisleLock' = [aisleLock EXCEPT ![a] = r]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![r] = a]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<binLock, fineHeld, load>>

LockBin(r, b) ==
    /\ held[r] = AisleOf(b)
    /\ binLock[b] = none
    /\ fineHeld[r] = noBin
    /\ binLock' = [binLock EXCEPT ![b] = r]
    /\ fineHeld' = [fineHeld EXCEPT ![r] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleLock, held, load>>

Deposit(r) ==
    /\ fineHeld[r] # noBin
    /\ TotalLoad < TotalCap
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![fineHeld[r]] = load[fineHeld[r]] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleLock, binLock, held, fineHeld>>

Withdraw(r) ==
    /\ fineHeld[r] # noBin
    /\ load[fineHeld[r]] > 0
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![fineHeld[r]] = load[fineHeld[r]] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleLock, binLock, held, fineHeld>>

UnlockBin(r) ==
    /\ fineHeld[r] # noBin
    /\ binLock' = [binLock EXCEPT ![fineHeld[r]] = none]
    /\ fineHeld' = [fineHeld EXCEPT ![r] = noBin]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleLock, held, load>>

UnlockAisle(r) ==
    /\ held[r] # noAisle
    /\ fineHeld[r] = noBin
    /\ aisleLock' = [aisleLock EXCEPT ![held[r]] = none]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![r] = noAisle]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<binLock, fineHeld, load>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robot, a \in Aisle : LockAisle(r, a)
    \/ \E r \in Robot, b \in Bin : LockBin(r, b)
    \/ \E r \in Robot : Deposit(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robot : Withdraw(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robot : UnlockBin(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robot : UnlockAisle(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected == TotalLoad =< TotalCap

Storage is arranged hierarchically: each bin sits inside an aisle, and a robot must first take the coarse lock on the bin's aisle before it may take the fine lock on the bin. Total == Len(queue) + Cardinality(Busy)

    /\ done = {}

    /\ Total < CAP
    /\ ~InSystem(r)
    /\ r \notin done
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, r)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inproc, crashed, done>>

Start(w) ==
    /\ w \notin crashed
    /\ inproc[w] = noReq
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ inproc' = [inproc EXCEPT ![w] = Head(queue)]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, done>>

Complete(w) ==
    /\ w \notin crashed
    /\ inproc[w] # noReq
    /\ done' = done \cup {inproc[w]}
    /\ inproc' = [inproc EXCEPT ![w] = noReq]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, crashed>>

    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, inproc, done>>

Recover(w) ==
    /\ w \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, inproc, done>>

    /\ inproc[w] # noReq
    /\ done' = done \cup {inproc[w]}
    /\ inproc' = [inproc EXCEPT ![w] = noReq]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, crashed>>

    \/ \E w \in Worker : Start(w)
    \/ \E w \in Worker : Complete(w)
    \/ \E w \in Worker : Crash(w)

The buffer's capacity counts both requests still waiting in the queue and requests currently being processed by workers. A new request is enqueued only while the total in-flight count is below capacity, providing backpressure. A crashed worker may later recover and resume, and a supervisor may reclaim the stuck request of a crashed worker, freeing that slot.     /\ lobby' = [lobby EXCEPT ![ToOf(r)] = lobby[ToOf(r)] + 1]
    /\ transit' = [transit EXCEPT ![r] = transit[r] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<matched, token>>

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lobby, transit, matched>>

Match(l) ==
    /\ lobby[l] >= 1
    /\ lobby' = [lobby EXCEPT ![l] = lobby[l] - 1]
    /\ matched' = matched + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<transit, token>>

Unmatch(l) ==
    /\ matched >= 1
    /\ matched' = matched - 1
    /\ lobby' = [lobby EXCEPT ![l] = lobby[l] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<transit, token>>

Next ==
    \/ \E from \in Lobby, to \in Lobby : Release(from, to)
    \/ \E r \in Route : Deliver(r)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E l \in Lobby : Match(l)
    \/ \E l \in Lobby : Unmatch(l)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conservation ==
    SumF(lobby, Lobby) + SumF(transit, Route) + matched = TOTAL

nl: A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker shuffles players between lobbies arranged in a ring, with exclusive permission to move a player granted by a circulating token. The lobby currently holding the token may release one of its players into transit toward another lobby. Transit messages travel over a network where messages can be reordered, so any player in transit on any route may be delivered in any order into the destination lobby. The token is passed to the next lobby in the ring. A player waiting in a lobby may be placed into a match, moving into the matched pool, and a matched player may later leave the match and return to a lobby. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of players, summed over all lobbies, all in-transit routes, and the matched pool, is always exactly the fixed player count, so no player is ever created or destroyed.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m9p5t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Match, Player, MaxEpoch

ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat

VARIABLES epoch, pEpoch, pending, sealed, beacon
vars == <<epoch, pEpoch, pending, sealed, beacon>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ pEpoch \in [Player -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ pending \subseteq Match
    /\ sealed \subseteq Match
    /\ beacon \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ pEpoch = [p \in Player |-> 0]
    /\ pending = Match
    /\ sealed = {}
    /\ beacon = FALSE

Sync(p) ==
    /\ pEpoch[p] # epoch
    /\ pEpoch' = [pEpoch EXCEPT ![p] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pending, sealed, beacon>>

Seal(p, m) ==
    /\ pEpoch[p] = epoch
    /\ m \in pending
    /\ pending' = pending \ {m}
    /\ sealed' = sealed \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pEpoch, beacon>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pEpoch, pending, sealed, beacon>>

Beacon ==
    /\ beacon' = ~beacon
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pEpoch, pending, sealed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Player : Sync(p)
    \/ \E p \in Player, m \in Match : Seal(p, m)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ Beacon

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AtMostOnceSeal ==
    \A m \in Match : m \in sealed => m \notin pending
=============================================================================

nl: A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker finalises matches through an epoch-numbered reconfiguration scheme. The matchmaker carries a configuration epoch that is bumped on each reconfiguration. Each player caches the epoch it has observed; players are slow but never fail, so a lagging player may hold a stale epoch for a while but always eventually syncs its cache up to the current epoch. Finalising a match by sealing it is an irreversible action: a player may seal a still-pending match only while running the current epoch, which moves the match out of the pending set and into the permanent sealed set, from which it never returns. A liveness beacon toggles to show the always-live participants are still responsive. SAFETY PROPERTY: once a match has been sealed it is never again pending, so the irreversible sealing of a match happens at most once.
